name: Erase Tattoo
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 1, cleric 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, M, (gem dust with a value equal to twice the value of the tattoo to be removed)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You may use this spell to remove a mundane tattoo from a willing subject. If the subject is not willing to lose the tattoo, or the tattoo is enchanted, the spell fails and the material components are wasted. So long as the subject is willing, the tattoo is permanently removed upon the completion of the spell. If a subject has more than one tattoo, the spell can affect larger areas of skin at the same time, but the material cost increases accordingly.
